text: 中国首席经济学家论坛理事长、国际金融研究院院长连平表示，本次上调外汇存款准备金率，是央行在当前人民币偏强、外汇供给较充裕背景下，对汇率单边波动和外汇流动性所作的一次宏观审慎调节，其目的是避免单边快速升值预期、增强市场双向弹性、提高机构风险意识，意在前瞻性引导金融机构、出口企业和个人理性对待汇率风险，增强套期保值等外汇风险对冲工具运用的意识。
text_en: Lian Ping, chairman of the China Chief Economist Forum and dean of the International Finance Institute, said the latest increase in the FX deposit reserve ratio is a macroprudential adjustment by the PBOC to one-sided exchange rate fluctuations and FX liquidity against the backdrop of a relatively strong renminbi and ample foreign exchange supply. Its purpose is to avoid expectations of rapid one-sided appreciation, enhance two-way market flexibility, raise institutions' risk awareness, and proactively guide financial institutions, exporters and individuals to treat exchange rate risk rationally and increase their awareness of using hedging and other FX risk tools.
